units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 6:25">Targ. Y. Deut. VI, 25</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 20:2">Targ. Y. Num. XX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מוליף ז׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00452">preced.</cite> a. <cite ref="A01934"><he>אֲלַף</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:30">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ דידי ודידך</he> my merit and thine.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10b:6">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי ז׳</he> where is the benefit (that the word <he>זכה</he> can be used)?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זַכְוָון</he>, <he>זַכְוָותָא</he>, <he>זַכְוָ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:10">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>מנכו לי מז׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>מזַכְוָותָאַי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) it may be deducted from my reward in the world to come.
Ḥag. 15ᵃ למיכתב ז׳ וכ׳ to record the merits of Israel; למימחק ז׳ וכ׳ to wipe out the record of &c.; a. e.—Esp. (pl.) verdict in favor, title, claims.
<cite ref="Ketubot 85a:14">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>כתבו לי ז׳ וכ׳</he> give me in writing your decision in my favor, that they must pay &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 27a:6">Ned. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>דאתפיס ז׳ וכ׳</he> whose papers were deposited in court; <he>ליזלון הני זַכְוָותָאַי</he> these my papers (claims) shall be void.
